sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Explicit vs. Implicit
lecture_lines: Explicit functions are like a neatly folded shirt.
Implicit relations are like a tangled ball of yarn.
Recall the Chain Rule for differentiation.
animations: Create label "Explicit" (#FFFFFF) and "Implicit" (#FFFFFF).
Fade in two distinct function examples on screen alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shirt.svg].
Highlight "y = f(x)" for explicit functions.
Highlight "f(x, y) = 0" for implicit functions.
Show transformation between explicit and implicit forms using a strand of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/yarn.svg].

sections.title: The 'Secret Sauce': The Chain Rule for y
lecture_lines: Treat 'y' as a hidden function of 'x'.
animations: Display dy/dx formula in light blue (#ADD8E6).
Animate chain rule structure: dy/dx = dy/du * du/dx.
Show variable 'u' as a bridge between y and x using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg].
Highlight the derivative operator d/dx in yellow (#FFFF00).
Connect all components with lines for flow.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Execution: The Squirrel Problem
lecture_lines: Differentiate both sides with respect to x.
animations: Display an implicit curve with variable colors featuring a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg].
Show differentiation of each term with respect to x.
Animate group terms containing dy/dx on left.
Solve for dy/dx by factoring and dividing.
Highlight final dy/dx expression in green (#00FF00) alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing the Tangent Line
lecture_lines: Implicit derivative gives the tangent slope.
Slope depends on both x and y.
Tangent line visualizes the rate of change.
animations: Draw a curved line representing the function [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].
Mark a point (x0, y0) on the curve.
Show tangent line emerging from (x0, y0).
Display slope calculation m = dy/dx evaluated at point.
Label tangent line equation y - y0 = m(x - x0) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].

sections.title: Summary & Pro-Tips
lecture_lines: Always apply Chain Rule to 'y' terms.
Keep dy/dx terms on one side.
animations: Display key bullet point: "Differentiate all terms." [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg]
Display key bullet point: "Isolate dy/dx terms." [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnet.svg]
Display final takeaway: "Always check implicit consistency." [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/anchor.svg]
